'''Skip 72''' was an inhabited [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] on the [[Smuggler's Run/Legends|Smuggler's Run]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] speculated that it was damaged during the [[Bombing of the Smuggler's Run]], as it had [[Droid/Legends|droids]] on it.
